records.Name: Haunted High-Rise
records.UnlockDiscription: This tallest building in Paradox Plaza serves a dual purpose. On the ground floor is a fight club managed by the Hoodlum Demons, while the upper floors are used as residential spaces. One might wonder why two seemingly unrelated things are placed so close together. Does winning a fight qualify someone to reside there, or is it because some live there to recover from brutal injuries sustained during the fighting? You just might have to fight in the ring to find out.

records.Name: Whispering Walls
records.UnlockDiscription: Once a favorite spot for graffiti artists due to its expansive walls, this warehouse hidden at the end of a street has recently become known for eerie sounds that emanate from within.

records.Name: Seagull Arena Graffiti Area
records.UnlockDiscription: A striking urban totem erected to honor the spirit of justice. It marks the location of the Seagull Tribunal. By the way, think twice before using the elevator near the graffiti, unless you’re prepared for a duel of a lifetime.

records.Name: Skateboard Graffiti Area
records.UnlockDiscription: Well-known among the city’s skateboard enthusiasts. Beginners are strongly advised to start at the novice track to hone their skills instead.

records.Name: Racing Track
records.UnlockDiscription: If you’ve ever been startled by the roar of car engines late at night, this is the place to seek redress. However, be prepared for a wild street race—this area is a popular haunt for the street racing enthusiasts.

records.Name: Goudal
records.UnlockDiscription: The statue standing outside of Marine MechWorks. Despite their continuous denial that its frivolous style does not represent their core value, they sure don’t seem to be in any hurry to move it elsewhere.

records.Name: Marine MechWorks Building
records.UnlockDiscription: Marine MechWorks is the most powerful and affluent enterprise within District 9. If your career goal is to become a small part of a massive machine, this towering building is your destination.

records.Name: Assembling Ship
records.UnlockDiscription: Specializing in shipbuilding, Marine MechWorks has been the golden standard for both quality and craftsmanship. It’s said that they’re so popular, there’s a three-hundred-year wait list for any new orders.

records.Name: Heat Treatment Center
records.UnlockDiscription: “An environmentally friendly production model is just our basic standard,” reads a statement from the Marine MechWorks official website. “If our competitors seem skeptical, that’s because they’re technologically inferior.”

records.Name: Container Dock
records.UnlockDiscription: “When visiting, please stay at least one meter away from the containers,” advises Nana, the tour guide. “Even minor vibrations can set off incredible events, given that the containers hold industrial objects that are mostly incomprehensible to the general public.”
